## 70000 - 70008

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="70000">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />70000 ALLOC - Master allocation</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="70000">

This is a header exception; it is never generated within the application.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="70001">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />70001 ALLOC - Master meter has multiple products assigned for allocation day</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="70001">

This exception is generated when the Master Meter has more than one product assigned for the allocation contract day(s) selected. For example, in location MA_LIQ_EXC_LOC, there are two meter members:

- MA_LIQ_EXC_1
- MA_LIQ_EXC_2

In the month of November, MA_LIQ_EXC_1 has two different products on the same contract day, 11/15/2015. When attempting to perform the allocation from 11/14/2015 – 11/16/2015, the allocation cannot be completed because of the conflicting products on 11/15/2015 and this exception is thrown.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 580;height: 346;" />

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="70002">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />70002 ALLOC - Master meter products do not match</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="70002">

This exception is generated when a location has multiple master meters and the product on those meters does not match. For example, in location MA_LIQ_EXC_LOC, there are two meter members:

- MA_LIQ_EXC_1
- MA_LIQ_EXC_2

For the month of February 2016, MA_LIQ_EXC_1 has a single product for the entire month labeled PROPANE; whereas MA_LIQ_EXC_2 has the same product until Feb. 15, 2016 0:00:00 where the product in the pipeline changes to CRUDE. When allocating to a third meter \[MA_LIQ_EXC_3\], this exception will be thrown and the allocation will not take place:



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 589;height: 332;" />

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="70003">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />70003 ALLOC - Allocation meter has multiple products assigned for allocation day</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="70003">

This exception is generated when the meter that is being allocated to has more than one product for the contract days that it is being allocated too. For example, the meter being allocated \[MA_LIQ_EXEC_3\] to has two different products on contract day 10/15/2015. When attempting to perform the allocation from 10/14/2015 – 10/16/2015, the allocation cannot be completed because of the conflicting products on 10/15/2015 and this exception is thrown.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 596;height: 354;" />

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="70004">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />70004 ALLOC - Allocation meter product does not match master meter product</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="70004">

This exception is generated when the product on the meter being allocated to does not match the product on the Master Meter(s). For example, meter MA_LIQ_EXC_3 is the meter being allocated to for the month of December 2015 and its product for the entire month is Propane; however, the Master Meters, MA_LIQ_EXC_1 and MA_LIQ_EXC_2, both have a product of Crude. When the allocation is attempted for the contract month of December 2015, the process will stop not be possible and this exception will be thrown.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 578;height: 346;" />

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="70005">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />70005 ALLOC - Master meter components cannot be allocated to allocation meter</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="70005">

This exception is generated when the components from the analysis on the Master Meter(s) are different from the components on the Allocation Meter for the allocation time frame selected. The allocation cannot happen because the corresponding component values on the Allocation Meter are null. For example, the following component values are on the Master Meters \[MA_LIQ_EXC_1\] and \[MA_LIQ_EXC_2\] as well as on the Allocation Meter \[MA_LIQ_EXC_3\]:

|  |  |
|:--:|:--:|
| Master Meters | Allocation Meter |
| 

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 287;height: 352;" /> | 

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 289;height: 352;" /> |

When attempting to perform an allocation for the month of January, the following exception thrown and the allocation process will not be able to take place.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 585;height: 348;" />

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="70006">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />70006 ALLOC - Master meter data set type does not match other master meter data set</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="70006">

This exception is generated when the data set type on one meter within the Master location does not match the data set type of another or the other meter members within the same location. There are two possible data set types:

- Data Set Type 1 = Batch and/or Periodic Data only
- Data Set Type 2 = Batch and/or Periodic Data and Component Data

To resolve this exception, confirm all member meters have either Data Set Type 1 or Data Set Type 2.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="70007">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />70007 ALLOC - Allocation meter data set type does not match other allocation meter data set</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="70007">

This exception is generated when the data set type on one meter within the Allocation location does not match the data set type of another or the other meter members within the same location. There are two possible data set types:

- Data Set Type 1 = Batch and/or Periodic Data only
- Data Set Type 2 = Batch and/or Periodic Data and Component Data

To resolve this exception, confirm all member meters have either Data Set Type 1 or Data Set Type 2.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="70008">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />70008 ALLOC - Allocation meter data set type does not match master data set type</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="70008">

This exception is generated when the data set type on one meter within the Allocation location does not match the data set type of the meter members within the Master location. There are two possible data set types:

- Data Set Type 1 = Batch and/or Periodic Data only
- Data Set Type 2 = Batch and/or Periodic Data and Component Data

To resolve this exception, confirm all member meters in the Allocation location and the Master location have either Data Set Type 1 or Data Set Type 2.

</div>

</div>
